howItWorks.title: How AgriNova
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple and transparent journey from farm to market.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Join AgriNova as a farmer or buyer in minutes with secure verification.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Farmers publish available produce with photos and grade, while buyers discover verified crops.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Discuss quantity, quality specs, delivery terms, and fair pricing without intermediaries.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Finalize the deal with verified agreements and arrange convenient transport or farm pickup.

whyChoose.card2Desc: Access hyperlocal weather forecasts, live mandi prices, and actionable agricultural insights for timely harvesting.
